description: Generate AI use cases from the current business profile and readiness assessment for an existing organization. Returns normalized use case data with IDs you can pass to generate_blueprint.

count.description: Optional number of use cases to generate (1-3).

customerOrgId.description: Customer organization ID (UUID). Required for partner users accessing a customer org.

guidance.description: Optional guidance array. If provided, the first string is used.

guidanceText.description: Optional free-text guidance for the generation run.

strategicInitiativeId.description: Optional strategic initiative ID to target.

name: generate_use_cases
